about: What changed in the formal proof between the mirror commit the blueprint pins and the one Main.lean is read from: the two proof closures compared by name, per statement, and per blueprint Lean name. Written by tools/lean-edges/drift.py from Sutherland's export (the earlier pin) and the mirror's build cache (the later); the README beside it says how to rebuild it. No Lean was built.

proof.note: The export holds the dependency closure of the five main theorems, so a declaration missing from it is not used by the proof.
